WARNING: TEST VECTORS. The key pairs under `keys` were generated only for these vectors, are published in this repository, and are not secrets. Never configure them in any service. Written by make-vectors.mjs; edit that file, not this one.

howToRead.keys: Named key pairs. A vector's `keys` maps kid to a name here: `name` is that pair's public key PEM, `name/private` its private key PEM.
howToRead.verification: verifyGitScope(token, { keys, now, expected }) must give `result`: the payload, or exactly that reason.
howToRead.addresses: `repo` is the list entry for a profile whose only address is `address`; null means the address is refused (the profile cannot get a list).
howToRead.profiles: `repos` is the profile's list (sorted, no repeats); null means building it fails.
howToRead.decisions: decideGitRequest on a verified list with these `repos` must give `result`.

verification.name: valid-member-order-and-whitespace

verification.name: valid-last-second
verification.about: now = exp - 1.

verification.name: valid-iat-at-skew-limit

verification.name: malformed-empty

verification.about: No signature part.

verification.name: malformed-four-parts

verification.name: malformed-empty-signature
verification.about: ES256 header with an empty signature part.

verification.name: malformed-trailing-newline
verification.about: A valid token followed by a line feed.

verification.name: malformed-padding
verification.about: A valid token whose signature has '=' padding.

verification.name: malformed-non-canonical-base64
verification.about: The signature's last character changed to one that decodes to the same 64 bytes (non-zero unused bits).

verification.name: malformed-header-not-json
verification.about: The header is not JSON.

verification.name: malformed-header-not-an-object
verification.about: The header is a JSON array.

verification.name: malformed-no-kid
verification.about: The header has no kid.

verification.name: malformed-embedded-jwk
verification.about: The header carries its own public key (jwk) and the token is signed with it. No header member other than alg, typ, kid is allowed.

verification.name: malformed-crit
verification.about: The header has a crit member.

verification.name: too-large-by-one
verification.about: A correctly signed token of 16385 characters, one more than the limit.

verification.name: wrong-alg-none
verification.about: alg "none" with an empty signature.

verification.name: wrong-alg-hs256-public-key-as-secret
verification.about: alg HS256, with the HMAC keyed by the verifier's public key PEM.

verification.name: wrong-alg-rs256
verification.about: alg RS256, signed with an RSA key whose public key the verifier holds under the kid.

verification.name: wrong-alg-es384
verification.about: alg ES384, signed with a P-384 key whose public key the verifier holds under the kid.

verification.name: wrong-alg-lower-case
verification.about: alg "es256": the name is case-sensitive.

verification.name: wrong-type-jwt
verification.about: typ "JWT".

verification.name: wrong-type-other-token
verification.about: A correctly signed token of another type from the same signer.

verification.name: wrong-type-missing
verification.about: The header has no typ.

verification.name: wrong-type-case
verification.about: typ in another letter case.

verification.name: unknown-key-kid-not-held
verification.about: The verifier holds the right key, under another kid.

verification.name: unknown-key-no-keys
verification.about: The verifier holds no keys.

verification.name: unknown-key-rsa-key-held
verification.about: ES256 header, RSA signature, and the verifier holds that RSA public key under the kid.

verification.name: unknown-key-p384-key-held
verification.about: ES256 header, signed with a P-384 key that the verifier holds under the kid.

verification.name: unknown-key-private-key-held
verification.about: The verifier was given the signer's PRIVATE key PEM. A verifier accepts public key PEMs only.

verification.name: unknown-key-kid-not-a-string
verification.about: kid is a number.

verification.name: bad-signature-other-key
verification.about: Signed with a different P-256 key under the signer's kid.

verification.name: bad-signature-payload-replaced
verification.about: A token signed with access "r" whose payload was replaced by the same list with "rw".

verification.name: bad-signature-der-encoded
verification.about: A correct signature in ASN.1/DER form instead of the 64 bytes r || s. The usual mistake when a library's default output is used.

verification.name: bad-signature-all-zero
verification.about: r = 0 and s = 0.

verification.name: bad-signature-hmac-under-es256
verification.about: ES256 header, but the signature is an HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the public key PEM.

verification.name: bad-signature-rsa-under-es256
verification.about: ES256 header, RSA signature; the verifier holds the P-256 key.
